rows: Here is a standard. Meet it, and I will respect the match.
Brawling is fine if it has a purpose. I will judge it that way.
Risk is fair when you are honest about it. Be honest with me.
Pace, for me, is a choice. I respect a choice I can see.
The people deserve a hard match and a fair one. That is all I ask.
I want a fair contest, and I will work for it.
I do not need to boast. The work will say what it says.
Note the stance against the standard. It is calm and ready. That is enough.
Technique, measured against the standard. Show me a clean hold and I will show you mine.
Strikes are part of it. Hard is not the same as reckless. Remember that.
Danger is a fair thing to take if you can live with the result.
Stalling is not fair to the people paying. I would rather you did not.
The crowd deserves a clean contest. Give them one and I will do the same.
You claim the top standard. Earn it, and I will say it too.
Proud of your {strength}, fine, if it was earned. That is fine. Hard work deserves to be proud of.
I have seen your {strength}. It is a standard, and I will meet it.
You kept composed. Okay. That is the right way to meet a standard.
That meets the standard. We agree on the basics. That is a start.
I could be harsh about that. I would rather be fair, and that will sting more.
One count, to the standard. Clean and fair. Keep me down, and I will say so.
On the mat I will keep it hard and clean. That is the bar I hold.
Grounded or standing, the standard does not change.
Stay here and face me. I will meet you where you stand.
A fair answer. I will hold you to it, and I think you can meet it.
The standard is still open. I will wait for an honest answer.
That meets the standard. Let us keep the standard where it belongs.
That meets the bar. We will see the standard at the bell.
I will give this match a hard, fair finish, and I will not cut corners.
My approach is clean and direct. I will show you the work.
Whatever happens, both of us will know we met the standard.
It is not over. The standard is still in place.
I have one more thing to say, and it is about the standard.
I wouldn't accept that standard of evidence from anybody else. I cannot establish the accusation, and I withdraw it.
Fairness requires me to back up my words. I can't do that for this charge.
That's the standard I expect. Leave the accusation out and meet me fairly.
Good. We'll judge each other by the work we do in the ring.
Judge the work against the same standard for both of us. The match will give everyone the chance to do that.
We can earn a result without inventing a reason to dislike each other. I want a fair contest.
It would not be fair to treat an unsupported accusation as fact. What can a clean contest demonstrate?
Let us agree to the same standard. What can the people judge from our work in the ring?
You've prepared a response to my {strength}. I respect that. Now we both have to meet the standard in the ring.
I won't ask you to make allowances for my {strength}. I'll expect a fair defence, and I'll work just as hard against it.
